Entries.UsedFor: Second page of the same offset walk, deliberately OVERLAPPING page 1 (its first item repeats page 1's last item id 12346) so the cross-page primary-key dedupe can be asserted. Offset pagination over a mutating collection shifts the window, so page boundaries are not record boundaries — this fixture reproduces that.
Entries.Derivation: DERIVED from the same spec example: item[0] is the page-1 item id 12346 VERBATIM; item[1] is that same published record with `id` changed to 12347 (a second, distinct record is needed to prove dedupe drops only the duplicate). Only the `id` value differs from the vendor example; the shape is untouched. Declared here because it is not byte-verbatim.
